# Step

**Category:** Movement  
**Aliases:** Step

## What it does

Step lets you walk up full blocks — and taller obstacles, depending on the mode — without needing to jump manually. Whenever you walk into a ledge, the module handles the upward movement for you automatically, keeping your traversal fluid and uninterrupted.

Description basis: [publisher description](https://liquidbounce.net/docs/modules/movement/step). The module's behavior on a stock Minecraft 26.3 server has not been verified unless separately documented in [research](../../RESEARCH.md).
